lead.en: An illustrative gather, act and verify timeline.
lead.zh: 展示收集上下文、执行和验证的示意流程。

rule.en: The host supplies the whole illustrative timeline; this component makes no agent or tool calls.
rule.zh: 宿主提供示意流程数据；组件不会调用真实智能体或工具。

api.en: Use set_playing, step, restart and set_speed. Events report station changes and completion.
api.zh: 可调用 set_playing、step、restart 和 set_speed；事件报告站点变化和结束状态。

motion.en: The head follows the ring during playback and stays at its current position when paused; off-screen playback pauses. Reduced motion skips travel. Detailed visual transitions remain to be verified.
motion.zh: 播放时节点沿圆环移动，暂停时保持当前位置，离屏时暂停；减少动效时跳过中间轨迹。细节视觉过渡仍待验收。
